notices.movedGearReleased: Moved. {count, plural, one {# gear assignment} other {# gear assignments}} released. Reassign on the prep page.
notices.copiedNoCrew: Copied, without the crew: one of them is on another boat then, or the course needs an instructor. Add them on the Crew schedule.
notices.invalid: That didn’t save. Check the date, times, and seats, then try again.
notices.endBeforeStart: The trip has to end after it starts. Check the times.
notices.daysOutOfOrder: Each day’s date has to be the day after the one before it.
notices.daysSpanRepeat: A repeating departure has to finish before the next one starts. Shorten its days or repeat it less often.
notices.notAuthorized: Building the board is limited to owners, managers, and instructors.
notices.notFound: That departure is no longer on the board.
notices.notScheduled: A canceled trip can’t be moved. Reinstate it from its own page first.
notices.alreadySailed: The crew has already counted heads against this departure. Cancel it from its own page if the day is off.
notices.hasRoster: Divers have booked this departure, so it can’t be deleted. Cancel it from its own page.
notices.addedSeries: “{title}” is on the board: {count, plural, one {# trip} other {# trips}} scheduled.
notices.capacityAboveBoat: That capacity is above what the assigned boat holds.
notices.rehearsalRepeats: A rehearsal is a single departure. Untick Repeat, or leave Rehearsal off.
notices.capacityAboveCertificate: That capacity is above the passenger limit on the boat’s certificate.
notices.capacityAboveCertificateCount: {count, plural, one {The boat’s certificate allows # passenger. Pick a capacity no higher.} other {The boat’s certificate allows # passengers. Pick a capacity no higher.}}
notices.weekCopied: {count, plural, one {Copied # departure from last year. Add its crew from its page.} other {Copied # departures from last year. Add their crew from each one’s page.}}
notices.weekNotEmpty: This week already has departures, so nothing was copied.
notices.nothingToCopy: Last year’s departures for this week have already passed, so nothing was copied.

builder.impactWindowOther: Cancellations close {count} hours before it departs.
builder.copyDescription: Same dive, same seats, same price, with no divers.
builder.moreOptionsDescription: Description, multi-day, deposit, free-cancellation window, and repeating dates.
builder.viewOnlyNotice: Scheduling and editing trips is limited to owners, managers, and instructors.
builder.courseNote: {requirement} · add an instructor before sharing the session
builder.descriptionPlaceholder: Sites, conditions, who it’s for, required certs.
builder.isPrivateHint: Off the public schedule. Anyone with the link can see the departure and book a seat.
builder.isRehearsalHint: Nobody is charged, told, or counted. People you seat here are test divers.
builder.selfGuidedHint: Buddy pairs go in without a guide, so DiveDay stops asking you to roster one.
builder.daysDescription: Most departures are one day. A course weekend or a liveaboard that meets the same hours on consecutive days is a single trip: one roster, one set of waivers, one crew.
builder.payAtBookingDescription: Optional. When the trip is priced and the shop takes card payments, divers pay online as they book. Leave the deposit blank to charge the full fare up front.
builder.depositDescription: Charged now; the balance is still owed at the dock. Many shops set 20–30% of the fare.
builder.depositTitle: Only applies when set below the trip price.
builder.cancellationWindowDescription: Hours before departure a diver can cancel for a refund. Shown to divers. 48 hours is a common window.
builder.minimumBookingsDescription: Blank and the boat goes with whoever books. Set it and the booking page states the number. If it hasn’t got there by the deadline beside it, this departure cancels itself and tells everyone aboard.
builder.minimumDecisionDescription: How long before departure the call is made. Divers are told the exact moment when they book.
builder.requestPlanDescription: Checked people will be invited to this departure, not booked.
builder.patternFilled: Filled from your last {count} {weekday} departures. Change anything, or
builder.patternAlsoUsual: {time} · {title} ran on {count} of those days too.
builder.patternAlsoUsualUntitled: {time} · another departure ran on {count} of those days too.
